---
title: "Software"
---

ClimateKG software focuses on two core components developed in the project:

### 1. CKG Scrape

A web scraping and ETL pipeline that converts the full IPCC AR6 web corpus into
structured knowledge graph content for MediaWiki and Wikibase, including full
text and linked data.

- Details: [CKG Scrape](ckg-scrape.qmd)
- Online: [GitHub repository](https://github.com/TIBHannover/CKG-Scrape)

### 2. CKG Data

An XML/DTD-based data framework for import/export, validation, portability, and
distribution of ClimateKG data.

- Details: [CKG Data](ckg-data.qmd)
- Online: [CKG Data page](https://tibhannover.github.io/ClimateKG-Data-Bench/ckg-data)
